files.content:
# payments-gateway

NorthBridge payments-gateway handles card authorization, settlement, and refund processing.

## Layout

- `src/gateway/` — service code
- `config/` — runtime configuration
- `CHANGELOG.md` — release history

## Releasing

Releases are cut from `main` via a release pull request opened through ReleasePilot. PRs route to the release-reviewer queue for sign-off before the release is tagged.

service: payments-gateway
environment: production
auth_timeout_ms: 2000
auth_max_retries: 2
settlement_batch_size: 250
settlement_flush_interval_seconds: 60
refund_window_days: 90
log_level: info

# Changelog

## [1.8.3] - Unreleased

- Handle final-attempt authorization timeouts gracefully
- Tighten settlement batch flush logging

## [1.8.2] - 2026-04-15

- Add refund status webhook endpoint
- Reduce settlement batch memory footprint
- Upgrade card processor SDK to 4.2

commits.message: Add diagnostic logging around authorization timeouts

pull_requests.title: Handle final-attempt authorization timeouts gracefully
pull_requests.body:
Catches the timeout raised on the final authorization attempt and returns a structured decline to the caller instead of an unhandled exception.

Follow-up from the production errors earlier this week.
